arabic_text: وَ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ صَلاةً لا غايَةَ لِعَدَدِها وَ لا نِهايَةَ لِمَدَدِها وَ لا نَفادَ لاَِمَدِها
transliteration: wa ṣallī ʿalayhi ṣalātan lā ghāyata liʿadadihā wa lā nihāyata limadadihā wa lā nafā
english_text: Bless him with blessings, (that) cannot be counted in numbers, cannot be "proximated" in space of time, cannot be consumed in terms of having nothing remaining.

arabic_text: اَللّـهُمَّ وَ اَقِمْ بِهِ الْحَقَّ وَ اَدْحِضْ بِهِ الْباطِلَ وَ اَدِلْ بِهِ اَوْلِياءَكَ وَ اَذْلِلْ بِهِ اَعْداءَكَ
transliteration: allāhumma wa aqim bihi al-ḥaqq wa adhiḍ bihi al-bāṭil wa adil bihi awliyā'aka wa adhil bhi a'd
english_text: Let us be friends with his ancestors. Give us courage to disperse those who oppose and try to prevent him, and make them stay in their shame and disgrace for ever.

arabic_text: وَ صِلِ اللّهُمَّ بَيْنَنا وَ بَيْنَهُ وُصْلَةً تُؤَدّى اِلى مُرافَقَةِ سَلَفِهِ وَ اجْعَلْنا مِمَّنْ يَأخُذُ بِحُجْزَتِهِمْ ، وَ يَمْكُثُ في ظِلِّهِمْ
transliteration: wa ṣilillāhumma baynanā wa baynahū waṣlataan tu'addi ilā murāfaqati ṣalafihi wa ijʿalna mimman ya'khudhu bihujzatihim, wa yamkuthu fi thillihim.
english_text: Help us to discharge the duties made incumbent upon us by him, and make every effort to obey him, keep from that which is declared unlawful by him, rely upon him to get his approval.

arabic_text: وَ اَعِنّا عَلى تَأدِيَةِ حُقُوقِهِ اِلَيْهِ ، وَ الاْجْتِهادِ في طاعَتِهِ ، وَ اجْتِنابِ مَعْصِيَتِهِ
transliteration: wa aʿinna ʿala taʾdiyat-i ḥuqūq-ihi ilayhi, wa al-ijtihād-i fī ṭaʿāt-ihi
english_text: Help us to discharge the duties made incumbent upon us by him, and make every effort to obey him, keep from that which is declared unlawful by him, rely upon him to get his approval.

arabic_text: وَ امْنُنْ عَلَيْنا بِرِضاهُ ، وَهَبْ لَنا رَأَفَتَهُ وَ رَحْمَتَهُ وَ دُعاءَهُ وَ خَيْرَهُ مانَنالُ بِهِ سَعَةً مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ وَ فَوْزاً عِنْدَكَ
transliteration: wa amnun ʿalayna bi riḍāhu, wa hab lana raʾfatuhu wa raḥmatuhu wa duʿāʾahu wa khayrah ma nanālu bihī saʿatan min raḥmatika wa fawzan ʿindaka
english_text: Let us be with him when he makes peace, and frees mankind from fear, gives currency to love are kindness, brings bliss and happiness, spreads good and virtue, so that we may do our best to promote his cause through Thy mercy, and win victory for Thee.

arabic_text: وَ اجْعَلْ صَلاتَنا بِهِ مَقبُولَةً ، وَ ذُنُوبَنا بِهِ مَغْفُورَةً ، وَ دُعاءَنا بِهِ مُسْتَجاباً اَرْزاقَنا بِهِ مَبْسُوطَةً ، وَ هُمُومَنا بِهِ مَكْفِيَّةً ، وَ حَوآئِجَنا بِهِ مَقْضِيَّةً
transliteration: wa aj'al ṣalātanā bihi maqbūlatan, wa dhunūbanā bihi maghfūratan, wa du'ā'anā bihi mustajāban arzaqanā bihi mabsoṭah, wa humūmānā bihi makfiyyah, wa ḥawā'ijanā bihi maqdhiyyah.
english_text: Accept our prayers, forgive our sins, fulfil our desires, give us means of livelihood, unrestricted, make less our hardships, meet our demands in full (through him).

arabic_text: وَ اَقْبِلْ اِلَيْنا بِوَجْهِكَ الْكَريمِ وَ اقْبَلْ تَقَرُّبَنا اِلَيْكَ
transliteration: wa aqbil ilayna biwajhika alkareem wa iqbal taqarrubana ilayka
english_text: Turn towards us Thy kindness and loving aspects, and bring us close to Thee.

arabic_text: وَ انْظُرْ اِلَيْنا نَظْرَةً رَحيمَةً نَسْتَكْمِلُ بِهَا الْكَرامَةَ عِنْدَكَ ، ثُمَّ لا تَصْرِفْها عَنّا بِجُودِكَ وَ اسْقِنا مِنْ حَوْضِ جَدِّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ بِكَأسِهِ وَ بِيَدِهِ رَيّاً رَوِيّاً هَنيئاً سائِغاً لا ظَمَاَ بَعْدَهُ يا اَرْحَمَ الرّاحِمين
transliteration: wa ondhur ilayna naẓratan raḥīmatan nastakmilu biha al-karāmata ʿindaka, thumma lā tasrifha ʿann wa isqina min hawdi jaddihi sallallahu 'alayhi wa alihi bikasihi wa biyadihi rayyan rawiyyan hani'an sa'ighan la thama ba'dahu ya arham alrahimeen
english_text: Turn the eyes of Thy mercy upon us, to bring to fullness Thy kind favours, and after that do not ever let them disappear in the name of Thy generosity, and give us the opportunity to quench our thirst from the spring of his great grandfather (Kawsar), (blessing of Allah be on him and on his children), using his cup, filled by him, fresh and pure, sufficient, wholesome, clear and cool, not leaving any desire thereafter, O the Most Merciful.
